audience: HR professionals and managers in the Arab world scrolling social media, who see a new workshop announcement
promise: AI × HR is a new hands-on workshop that moves HR from traditional practice to AI-powered practice, with practical tools and cases
cta: I'M INTERESTED — اكتب في الكومنت (the poster's own call to action; no date, price or contact shown because none was supplied)
direction: One hero: the ×. Electric blue and cyan on deep navy with a yellow slab for the payoff, Alexandria extruded 3D type, CSS 3D scenes (orbit, flip cards, cylinder ring, floor grid), camera shakes on the beats, white flashes as transitions. 144 BPM original score locked to the cuts.

assets.rights: Owner-supplied announcement poster; copy and hosts' names reused as given, artwork not copied
Owner-supplied workshop poster; list of before/after areas and ingredients reused as given

creative.viewer: an HR manager or specialist scrolling past dozens of posts
creative.problem: HR still works the traditional way while AI changes the job
creative.promise: a practical workshop that turns HR into AI-powered HR
creative.evidence: only the owner's poster copy: two named hosts, six before/after areas, workshop ingredients
creative.motif: the multiplication sign × that scratches, spins and becomes the lock-up
creative.light: electric blue glow on deep navy with white flashes and a yellow payoff
creative.camera: CSS 3D perspective rig, orbit, push-through and beat shakes
creative.motion: springs, extruded 3D type, flips, particle sparks, speed lines
creative.sound: 120 BPM western dance-pop: four-on-the-floor, offbeat hats and octave bass, one syncopated 3-3-2 hook in every chapter, snare build into the biggest drop
creative.pacing: one idea per two bars, rhythm escalating to the smash at 21.7 s
creative.payoff: WORKSHOP COMING SOON with the AI×HR lock-up and the call to comment
